verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a unified `.forget` deletion command supporting single data item deletion, dataset (per-entity/group) deletion, and full cleanup of all memory for the current user — directly matching the story's single/per-entity/full erasure requirement, and this is reinforced by dataset-scoped permissions enabling per-user isolation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of deletion completeness (e.g., confirming underlying vector/graph store purge) and no explicit audit-log or compliance certification evidence.
